title: Campaign lift under selection bias
prompt: A loyalty campaign claims a 12-point repeat-purchase lift. Determine whether the causal claim is supported.
facts: Campaign recipients were selected from customers with above-median prior purchase frequency.
Recipients had 61% repeat purchase versus 49% among non-recipients.
Before the campaign, the same recipient cohort already had 58% repeat purchase.
No randomized holdout or matched comparison was used.
Customer mix changed during the campaign period.
